慢悠悠的温柔伙伴，陪你多享受一点时光。: A gentle, easygoing friend who gives you a little more time.

引爆场上最多 {n} 枚炸弹；\\u{200B}场上没有炸弹时，\\u{200B: Sets off up to {n} bombs on the board; with none, places 2 to set off next time.
闹腾又开心，\\u{200B}一刻停不下来！: Noisy and happy, never sits still!
获得 {n} 分\\u{200B}并推进订单: Gains {n} points and advances the order
每消除 {spoolEvery} 件商品，就送你 1 个线消；交换时直接连出四件: Every {spoolEvery} goods cleared gives you a line clear; a swap that makes four in a row gives one more.
线消发动时，会同时清掉它所在的一整行和一整列。: A line clear clears both its whole row and its whole column.
每引爆 {relayEvery} 个线消，就送你 {relayGive} 个线消: Every {relayEvery} line clears set off give you {relayGive} more.
被线消清掉的商品，得分多 {tip%}%。: Goods cleared by a line clear score {tip%}% more.
同一次交换里接连引爆线消时，第 2 个得分多 {finaleStep%}%，之后: Line clears set off one after another in a swap score more: the 2nd +{finaleStep%}%, each later one +{finaleStep%}% more, up to +{finaleMax%}%.
每交一单，就送你 {bowCount} 个线消，一个清行，一个清列。: Each order delivered gives you line clears ×{bowCount}: one for a row, one for a column.
线消发动时，一次清掉两行或两列。: A line clear clears two rows or two columns at once.
炸弹和线消合在一起算，每引爆 {ribbonEvery} 个，就再得 {coun: Every {ribbonEvery} bombs or line clears set off (counted together) add {counterScore} points to the current order.
每有 {foamEvery} 次交换成功消除，补货时就送你 1 枚炸弹。: Every {foamEvery} swaps that clear something, the restock brings you a bomb.
每引爆 {coreEvery} 枚炸弹，就送你 {coreGive} 枚炸弹。: Every {coreEvery} bombs set off give you {coreGive} more bombs.
被炸弹炸掉的商品，得分多 {caramel%}%。: Goods blasted by a bomb score {caramel%}% more.
同一次交换里接连炸了好几枚炸弹时，第 2 枚得分多 {candleStep%}%: Bombs set off one after another in a swap score more: the 2nd +{candleStep%}%, the 3rd and later +{candleMax%}%.
每交一单，就送你 1 枚炸弹。: Each order delivered gives you a bomb.
每引爆 1 枚炸弹或 1 个线消，上场的猫各攒 {fuseCharge} 点能量: Each bomb or line clear set off gives every cat on duty {fuseCharge} energy.
每引爆 {specialEvery} 枚炸弹，就再得 {counterScore: Every {specialEvery} bombs set off add {counterScore} points to the current order.
补货时只会出现 4 种商品，两种偏好品一定在里面。: Restocks bring only 4 kinds of goods, always including both wanted goods.
每次交换后补货时，会把棋盘上 1 件商品变成偏好品。: After each swap, the restock turns one good on the board into a wanted good.
连消到第 3 轮以后，消除偏好品的得分再多 {regular%}%。: From the 3rd combo step on, wanted goods score {regular%}% more.
每消除 {windowEvery} 件偏好品，接下来补上的 {windowRef: Every {windowEvery} wanted goods cleared, the next {windowRefill} restocked goods are all wanted goods.
每交一单，下次补货时会把 {sampleConvert} 件商品变成偏好品。: Each order delivered turns goods ×{sampleConvert} into wanted goods at the next restock.
每消除 {rushEvery} 件偏好品，就再得 {counterScore}: Every {rushEvery} wanted goods cleared add {counterScore} points to the current order.
每交一单，下一单就先装进 {ledger} 分。: Each order delivered starts the next one with {ledger} points.
所有加时都多 {hourglass%}%，越到后面加得越少这一点不变。: All time bonuses are {hourglass%}% bigger; they still shrink later in the day.
从下一单起，每单需要的分数少 {stamp%}%。: From the next order on, each order needs {stamp%}% fewer points.
在棋盘上\\u{200B}放 {0} 个线消。: Places {0} line clears on the board.
把相邻的两件商品交换位置，让三件一样的商品连成一排，它们就会被消除。: Swap two neighbouring goods. When three of the same kind line up, they are cleared.
每消除一件商品都会得分，这些分会装进顾客的订单。订单上画着两种偏好品，消除偏好品: Every good you clear scores points, and the points fill the customer's order. The order shows two wanted goods; clearing them scores twice as much.
订单的分数装满，就会自动交单，同时给你加一点营业时间，然后换下一位顾客。: When the order is full, it is delivered automatically, you get a little more shop time, and the next customer comes.
商品消除后，上面的商品会落下来补位。落下来如果又凑成一排，就会接着消除，这叫连消: After a clear, the goods above fall into the gap. If they line up again, they clear too: that is a combo. The longer the combo, the more each clear scores.
四件一样的商品连成一排时，会留下一个线消。横着连出来的线消，发动时清掉它所在的那: Four of a kind in a line leave a line clear. One made from a horizontal line clears its whole row when it goes off; one made from a vertical line clears its whole column.
五件或更多一样的商品连成一排时，会留下一个彩色毛线团。点一下毛线团，场上所有和订: Five or more of a kind in a line leave a rainbow yarn. Tap it to clear every good on the board that matches the order's first wanted good; swap it with a neighbour to clear every good of that neighbour's kind.
横着一排和竖着一排一样的商品，在同一件商品上交叉时，也就是摆成 T 字形或 L: When a horizontal and a vertical line of the same kind cross on one good (a T or L shape), they leave a bomb. It takes at least 5 goods: 3 across and 3 down, sharing the crossing one. No line clear is made then. A bomb blasts the 3×3 goods around it.
交叉的两排里，如果有一排达到 5 件，这一排照样会留下彩色毛线团，交叉的地方再多: If one of the crossing lines has 5 goods, it still leaves a rainbow yarn, plus a bomb at the crossing; if both have 5, each leaves a rainbow yarn. When two special pieces would land on the same spot, only the rainbow yarn stays.
线消和炸弹仍然算它原来那种商品，和同样的商品连成一排被消除时，就会发动。它们被别: Line clears and bombs still count as their kind of good: they go off when cleared in a line with matching goods. They also go off when another special piece hits them, so one special piece often sets off the next.
每局开始时有 {0} 秒倒计时，倒计时走到 0，小店就打烊。: Each round starts with a {0}-second countdown. When it reaches 0, the shop closes.
每交一单，倒计时会多几秒。越到后面加得越少，倒计时最多攒到 {0} 秒。: Each order delivered adds a few seconds. The bonus shrinks later in the day, and the countdown holds at most {0} seconds.
不过一局最长只营业 {0} 秒，也就是 {1} 分钟。到了 {1} 分钟，就算倒: A round lasts at most {0} seconds ({1} minutes). At {1} minutes the shop closes even if the countdown has time left. Orders delivered in the last {2} seconds add no time.
暂停、挑道具和看手册的时候，倒计时不会走。: The countdown stops while you pause, pick an item or read the handbook.
交完第 {0} 单时，顾客会送来三件谢礼，你可以从里面挑一件道具带上。一局最多带: After orders {0}, the customer brings three gifts and you pick one item to keep. You can carry up to {1} items per round.
每件道具带一到两个标签。同标签的道具搭在一起，效果往往更强。每件道具具体做什么，: Each item has one or two tags. Items with the same tag often work better together. What each item does is written on its card.
不喜欢这三件谢礼，可以重抽换一组。每局有 {0} 次免费重抽；每有一只亲密等级到: Don't like the three gifts? Reroll for a new set. You get {0} free reroll per round, plus one more for each cat on duty at bond level Lv5.
挑谢礼时看一次广告，可以再多 {0} 次重抽。这种广告每天最多看 {1} 次，和: While picking a gift, watching an ad adds {0} more rerolls. You can watch this ad up to {1} times a day, separate from the ad for points at the end of a round.
每局最多带两只猫上场，两只猫互为搭档。: Up to two cats can be on duty each round, and they are each other's partners.
你每次交换消除了几件商品，上场的猫就各攒几点能量，一次最多攒 12 点。能量攒满: Each swap gives every cat on duty one energy for each good you clear, up to 12 at a time. When a cat's energy is full, it steps in to help.
猫清掉的商品、放出来的炸弹和线消，都和你自己消除的一样，会触发道具效果。: Goods cats clear, and bombs and line clears they place, trigger item effects just like your own clears.
提升猫的亲密等级，它攒满能量会更快，帮忙的效果也更强。: Raising a cat's bond level makes it fill its energy faster and help more.
每局结束时，这局的成绩会换成养猫积分。成绩越高，换到的积分越多，不过有上限。每天: At the end of each round, your score turns into cat points. A higher score gives more points, up to a limit. Only the first {0} rounds each day earn points.
每天第一次完成结算，会额外送你 {0} 养猫积分。: Your first finished round each day gives you {0} bonus cat points.
养猫积分可以用来领养新猫，也可以提升猫的亲密等级。: Spend cat points to adopt new cats or raise their bond level.
结算时还可以看广告，再领一次这局的积分。当天第 1 次能领 2 倍\\u{200: At the end of a round you can watch an ad to collect the round's points again: the 1st time each day ×2 (at least {0}), the 2nd ×1 (at least {1}), the 3rd half (at least {2}).
